quality.label: Quality setting for Tidal:
quality.description: The maximum streaming quality to request from Tidal.

option_descriptions.LOSSLESS: 16-bit / 44.1 kHz — CD quality, plays on any device.
option_descriptions.HI_RES_LOSSLESS: Up to 24-bit / 192 kHz — hi-res; needs a player/DAC that supports it.

oops_url.label: Redirect URL from Tidal
oops_url.description: Paste the URL of the 'Page Not Found' page you were redirected to after signing in on Tidal.com.

auth_instructions.label: Use the link icon to open Tidal and sign in. Afterwards you land on a page that says 'Page Not Found' - that is expected. Copy the full URL from your browser's address bar and paste it below.

user.title: Link your Tidal account
user.description: Open the Tidal sign-in page with the link icon. After signing in you land on a 'Page Not Found' page — copy that URL from the address bar and paste it below.

manifest.description: Stream music, playlists, and exclusives in lossless FLAC quality.
